topStories.headline: Early Voting Ends Today; Ellis County Heads to the Polls Tuesday
topStories.dek: The final day of early voting falls on October 30, with Election Day set for November 3 and a ballot that includes street-repair and emergency-services tax questions.
topStories.body:
Ellis County voters have until the close of polls today, Friday, October 30, to cast an early ballot before Election Day arrives on Tuesday, November 3. Early voting sites — including the Waxahachie ISD old high school library at 1000 N. U.S. Highway 77 and the Knights of Columbus hall at 325 Broadhead Road — are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. today. Because Ellis County uses countywide polling, voters may cast a ballot at any vote center regardless of their home precinct.

Election Day polls will also run from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. on November 3. The county's Elections Department, overseen by administrator Jana Onyon, reports that as of October 1 there were 159,039 registered voters in Ellis County.

The November ballot carries several local measures beyond state and federal races. Ennis voters will weigh Proposition A, which would reauthorize sales-tax funding for street repairs. Residents in the coverage area of Ellis County Emergency Services District No. 5 face a separate Proposition A asking them to approve a property-tax-rate increase for emergency services. A full list of contests — including county judicial offices, commissioner races, and other local propositions — is available through the sample-ballot link on the Ellis County Elections website at elliscountytx.gov.

topStories.headline: Commissioners Vote Unanimously to Name Butler Judge Pro Tem
topStories.dek: Ellis County Commissioners Court voted at its October 28 meeting to designate Commissioner Kyle Butler of Precinct 4 as judge pro tempore.
topStories.body:
The Ellis County Commissioners Court voted unanimously at its Wednesday, October 28, 2026, meeting to name Precinct 4 Commissioner Kyle Butler as judge pro tempore, according to the Ellis County Press. The designation allows Butler to preside over commissioners court sessions when the sitting county judge is absent or recused.

Butler, a Republican who has represented Precinct 4 since 2015, is himself on the November 3 ballot facing Democratic challenger Oyinkansola (OJ) Jinadu. His term is currently set to expire December 31, 2026. The pro tem appointment ensures continuity of court operations through the end of the current term and through any transition period following the election.

The Commissioners Court meets regularly in Waxahachie at the county courts and administration building at 109 South Jackson Street.

topStories.headline: City Council Picks Restaurant Group to Redevelop Long-Vacant Former Police Building
topStories.dek: On a 4-1 vote October 6, the Waxahachie City Council authorized negotiations with Hart Systems Inc. for a Chapter 380 agreement to bring new life to the historic South Rogers Street property.
topStories.body:
The Waxahachie City Council voted 4-1 at its October 6, 2026, regular meeting to begin formal negotiations with Hart Systems Inc. — operators of a popular local restaurant — for a Chapter 380 economic-development agreement aimed at redeveloping the city-owned former police department building downtown. The vote was reported by the Waxahachie Daily Light.

The building, located at 216 N. College Street, has been vacant since the police department vacated it in 2018. It has attracted significant community interest over the years; an earlier effort to convert it into a food hall called Waxahachie Social stalled in early 2026 after the development group missed a required funding deadline. The city then sought new proposals.

A Chapter 380 agreement allows a Texas municipality to provide economic incentives to a private developer in exchange for investment, job creation, or other community benefits. Details of the proposed agreement — including the scope of the restaurant concept and any public subsidies — are expected to emerge during the negotiation phase before a final deal returns to the council for approval.

events.description: District play continues for Week 10 of the high school football season; the Waxahachie Indians are among the area teams in action Friday night. Check the Ellis County Press for full schedules and opponent information.

moreNews.headline: Waxahachie Fire-Rescue Lands $3.87M FEMA Grant to Hire 15 Firefighters
moreNews.body: At its October 6, 2026, regular meeting, the Waxahachie City Council accepted a FEMA Staffing for Adequate Fire and Emergency Response (SAFER) grant totaling $3,873,662.73. The funding will be used to hire 15 new firefighters and support the department's move toward four-person staffing on frontline engines and aerial apparatus for structural fire calls. The council also adopted a supplemental appropriation to cover costs while awaiting federal reimbursement and passed an ordinance codifying the four-person staffing requirement. The grant was announced by Fire Chief Scott Safford, who called it a major milestone for the department.

moreNews.headline: Ellis County Tax Rate Raised 8.96 Percent for Fiscal Year 2027
moreNews.body: Ellis County has formally adopted a property tax rate for Tax Year 2026 (Fiscal Year 2027) that raises taxes for maintenance and operations by 8.96 percent compared to last year's rate. On a $100,000 home, the increase amounts to approximately $20.30 in additional taxes. All taxing jurisdictions within Ellis County had adopted and reported their rates as of October 13, 2026, according to the Waxahachie Sun. A comprehensive listing of every jurisdiction's rate was published by the Sun on October 13.

restaurants.name: College Street Pub
restaurants.description: A cozy British-style pub with a Texas flair in the heart of downtown Waxahachie, serving classic pub fare, draught beers, and local favorites with indoor and garden seating.

restaurants.name: The Dove's Nest

restaurants.name: Tuscan Slice

restaurants.name: Atkins Seafood
restaurants.description: A family-owned seafood market and casual restaurant sourcing fresh catches directly from their own fleet of boats out of Galveston since 2004.

restaurants.name: Ohana Sushi Ramen Poke
restaurants.description: A highly rated Japanese restaurant offering a full sushi bar, creative ramen, poke bowls, and a full liquor bar in a welcoming atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Southern Roots Brewing Company

restaurants.name: Panza's Tapping Italy
restaurants.description: A locally beloved Italian bistro near the courthouse square offering house-made bruschettas, pizzettas, Roman-style stuffed Taglio bread, light pastas, and in-house desserts using fresh, local ingredients.

restaurants.address: 500 W Madison St, Suite A1, Waxahachie, TX 75165

restaurants.name: Farm Luck Soda Fountain & Dry Goods
restaurants.description: An independently owned soda fountain inside the historic 1913 Waxahachie Bank & Trust building on the courthouse square, serving house-made malts, cream sodas, banana splits, soups, and sandwiches.
restaurants.address: 109 W Franklin St, Ste 119, Waxahachie, TX 75165

restaurants.name: Roma's Italian Restaurant
restaurants.description: A neighborhood Italian restaurant with a broad menu of classic dishes including lasagna, chicken alfredo, stuffed mushrooms, and garlic rolls.

restaurants.name: Big Al's Down The Hatch
restaurants.description: A casual bar and grill with a large patio, known for affordable food, live entertainment including musical bingo, and a lively local crowd.

restaurants.name: Mariscos Muelle 77
restaurants.description: A highly rated Mexican seafood restaurant open until midnight, celebrated for flavorful, fresh preparations and standout service.

restaurants.name: The Burger Spot
restaurants.description: A locally popular burger spot with consistently high ratings, open for lunch and dinner.

restaurants.name: Cajun Bros
restaurants.description: A Cajun-style restaurant serving boiled and fried seafood with affordable drinks in a casual, festive setting.

restaurants.name: Two Amigos Taqueria
restaurants.description: A beloved local taqueria rated 4.4 on TripAdvisor, consistently recommended for its authentic Mexican food at wallet-friendly prices.

hotels.name: Best Western Plus Waxahachie Inn & Suites

hotels.name: La Quinta Inn & Suites by Wyndham Waxahachie

hotels.name: Comfort Suites Waxahachie – Dallas

hotels.name: Motel 6 Waxahachie

gymsRecreation.name: Buffalo Creek CrossFit
